question: Compound interest on a certain sum of money invested for 1.5 years at the rate of 10% per annum, compounded half yearly is ₹5,044. What is the sum?
solution:
Given :

Compound Interest = 5,044

Rate = 10% per annum

Time = 1.5 years

Formula Used :

CI = P [(1 + r/100)T - 1]

Where P = Principle, r = Rate, T = Time
